tweets.text: RT @Kaiz_294: Zcash brought privacy back into the center of the crypto conversation Mert connects the renewed interest in privacy directly to Zcash's rise from the top 100 into the top 10. "Zcash, going from the top 100 to the top 10, played quite a large role in that." "Crypto, attention, liquidity equals price action." "It is one of the things left in finance that is player versus environment." "If I have privacy, and Laura, you have privacy, that's good for both of us." Price action creates attention. Attention brings liquidity, new participants and more opportunities for teams building in the sector. That's where Mert's PvE idea becomes interesting. Most financial markets are fundamentally competitive. One participant's gain can come from another participant's loss. Privacy works differently. If two people gain stronger financial privacy, both benefit from it. The utility expands across the network instead of requiring users to compete against each other for the same outcome. Zcash's recent rise therefore did more than move the token higher. It put privacy back on the industry's radar and gave the entire sector a new source of attention. Zcash moved. Privacy got attention. A forgotten crypto primitive started becoming a market again. w/ @mert

I never studied traditional majors, never even had a job, and never followed a standard career path And I felt right at home in this place. The missions is largely forgotten. There is very little idealism. tweets.text: RT @justinsuntron: 关于我与World Liberty @worldlibertyfi 的官司,很多人以为它是一场商业纠纷。表面上确实是——4500万美元、40亿枚代币、一纸合同。 但打了这几个月,我越来越清楚它真正的性质:这是一场关于区块链初心的价值观之争。 我们这一代人创立区块链,只为一个朴素的信念:每个人都应当真正拥有自己的财产——不因你的身份、立场、国籍,不需要任何人的恩准。 私钥即所有权,这是整个行业的第一性原理。 而这场官司揭示的,恰恰是对这一初心的背叛: 一家以"自由(Liberty)"为名的公司,在WLFI与USD1合约里秘密植入了任意冻结任何用户资产的权力,不经披露、不经治理、不经任何程序——然后在我的代币解锁数日之内,对我使用了它。 以自由之名,行控制之实——这不只是对我一个人的侵害,它动摇的是这个行业存在的理由。 如果发行方可以随时没收任何持有者的资产,那么区块链和它试图取代的旧世界还有什么区别? 我们绕了一大圈,只是给任意没收换了一层技术的包装。 所以这场官司我会打到底。 不只为拿回属于我的东西,更为在法庭上确立一个先例: 在区块链的世界里,"你的资产"必须真正是你的——写在代码里,也写进判例里。 自由不是一个可以注册的商标。 它是一种可以在链上逐行验证的设计选择。 我的选择,任何人都可以去验证;他们的,法庭正在验证。

tweets.text: RT @USTradeRep: Tonight, Canada declined to finalize the trade deal under the terms agreed earlier this week. Despite the U.S. offer to Canada to receive the best treatment of any major exporter to our market, new demands and walk backs of other commitments by Canada have upended the careful balance reached in the past days. In addition, Canada is continuing to maintain its prolonged retaliation against the United States, including, among other things, flat-out prohibitions on certain American goods and services. For decades, Canada has enjoyed the most favorable access to the U.S. market of any country. And from the beginning of President Trump’s trade program, Canada has continued to enjoy the best treatment in the world, even after – like China – retaliating against the United States. This week, the United States agreed to provide even better treatment to Canada, offering significant tariff reductions on steel, aluminum, autos, and lumber. The U.S. offer was also forward looking, and included a historic economic and national security partnership to cooperate on export controls, combat transshipment, enhance digital trade, and align certain external tariffs. The offer would have led to supply chain coordination on aerospace, complementary actions to address unfair trade practices, critical minerals cooperation, increased enforcement against imports produced with forced labor, and the announcement of formal U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) negotiations. This is a missed opportunity for Canada to partner with the United States, which is the fastest growing economy in the G7.
